candidates.claim: sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/20 is a registry-unused port but is an active access port in VLAN 10 with no shutdown, placing the OT zone VLAN on the DMZ core switch.
candidates.remediation: Move Gi1/0/20 back to VLAN 999 and shut it down, unless it is confirmed as an OT-facing port and the registry is updated.

candidates.claim: EDGE_IN permits any source to tcp/443 on fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2, an HTTPS path to the firewall outside the mgmt interface that the management policy restricts, while the ASA HTTP server is enabled globally.
candidates.remediation: Remove the rtr-01 EDGE_IN permit for tcp/443 to 203.0.113.2 and confirm that firewall HTTPS is served only on the mgmt interface from MGMT.

candidates.claim: The access VLAN on sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/20 differs from the approved baseline, changed from 999 to 10.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the access VLAN change on Gi1/0/20 or revert it to the approved value 999.

candidates.claim: The baseline shutdown command on sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/20 has been removed, so the port is enabled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile by restoring shutdown on Gi1/0/20 or documenting an approved change.

clarifications.question: rtr-01 has a second default route 0.0.0.0/0 via 10.10.99.1 (fw-01 mgmt interface, anchor rtr-01:55) alongside the outside default via 198.51.100.1 (rtr-01:54). Is this intended? It routes outside-sourced traffic toward the fw-01 MGMT-side interface, so please confirm it is not an alternate path into MGMT or OT.
